question: On the closed-FRW V=0 U_plus component, does the hash-verified exact Darboux constraint coordinate support an internally consistent local HTV-improved static BFV replacement-source algebra, with a bracket-derived nilpotent Abelian BRST charge, BRST-compatible endpoint polarization, an explicitly normalized oriented gauge zero-mode convention, and compatibility with the declared reduced canonical identity convention?

upstream_results.role: kills the append-to-unchanged-proper-time shortcut and leaves a separately derived improved-static replacement open
supplies the exact U_plus canonical chart, positive local FP factor, and endpoint boundary potential used by this source

primary_sources.used_for: the improved endpoint action, gauge-related endpoint states, local transversality, and permissibility of time-independent canonical gauges in generally covariant systems
primary_sources.not_used_for: deriving the repository Darboux chart, proving a global trace gauge, normalizing this endpoint source, or equating it to the old proper-time kernel

primary_sources.used_for: the extended multiplier pair, nilpotent BRST-BFV charge, fermionic gauge fixing, improved boundary term, and endpoint conditions with constraint ghost, antighost, and multiplier momentum set to zero
primary_sources.not_used_for: the model-specific constraint, this gauge fermion, a global BFV determinant, or a physical state

model.original_pairs: {Q,P}=1 and {phi,p}=1, with Q=2*log(a), P=a*p_a/2 and a>0
model.implicit_root: for every real c=C and (P,p) in U_plus, 72*pi^4*a^4+12*pi^2*c*a^3-R=0 has one smooth positive root
model.darboux_chart: W(c,P,p)=-integral_0^P Q(c,u,p)du, T=W_c, Phi=phi+W_p, with {T,c}=1 and {Phi,p}=1
model.static_slice: T_P=1/D>0 and T(c,0,p)=0, so T=0 iff P=0 on the declared component

bfv_convention.graded_bracket: use right derivatives on the left argument and left derivatives on the right argument; each odd canonical pair has the symmetric contribution (F right-d_theta)(left-d_pi G)+(F right-d_pi)(left-d_theta G)
bfv_convention.brst_differential: derive sF={F,Omega} from the complete graded BFV Poisson bracket; the resulting images are sT=c_g, sN=rho, sbar_c=Pi, sbar_rho=c, with c,Pi,Phi,p,c_g,rho invariant
bfv_convention.gauge_fixing_density: sPsi=Pi*T+N*c-c_g*bar_c-rho*bar_rho in the frozen odd order, derived from the graded bracket rather than an independently declared odd derivation
bfv_convention.hamiltonian_sign: following Garcia-Vergara-Urrutia, H_BFV=-{Psi,Omega} for vanishing canonical Hamiltonian, so the first-order action contains +sPsi
bfv_convention.multiplier_kinetic_boundary: -N*Pidot=Pi*Ndot-d(N*Pi)/dt; the boundary difference -[N*Pi] vanishes under the declared endpoint condition Pi=0
bfv_convention.endpoint_data: fix T=0 and Phi at both endpoints; impose c_g=bar_c=Pi=0 there; the conjugate c and N,rho,bar_rho are not silently fixed at the endpoints
bfv_convention.endpoint_ideal: (T,Pi,c_g,bar_c), with fixed Phi BRST invariant; c is explicitly absent from the endpoint ideal
bfv_convention.local_source: the declared full-real Fourier zero-mode measures dPi/(2*pi*hbar) and dN/(2*pi*hbar) give delta(T)*delta(c); delta(c) is a bulk/zero-mode integration result, not an endpoint boundary condition
bfv_convention.berezin_orientation: coefficient extraction uses the frozen monomial c_g*bar_c*rho*bar_rho
bfv_convention.berezin_measure_normalization: Integral_oriented Dtheta F := -hbar^2*[c_g*bar_c*rho*bar_rho]F, so the raw coefficient -1/hbar^2 of the quantum ghost phase is normalized to +1; this is a declared local zero-mode convention, not an absolute full BFV path measure

relational_identity_control.declared_measure: dp/(2*pi*hbar), after the separately normalized local gauge zero-mode factor
relational_identity_control.scope_warning: this is a consistency check of the declared canonical identity distribution for the single reduced relational pair; it is not derived as a two-endpoint full BFV trajectory kernel and is not a full-real-lapse delta(C) rigging map

exact_plan: hash-verify the upstream chart and recheck the downstream D>0, {T,c}=1, static-slice and local delta(P)*D=delta(T) identities used here
verify the Darboux one-form and endpoint boundary cancellation
implement the complete even graded BFV Poisson bracket, verify its declared fundamental pairs, and derive every BRST generator image from Omega
verify Omega has ghost number one and {Omega,Omega}=0, then derive sPsi and verify {sPsi,Omega}=0
verify the declared endpoint ideal (T,Pi,c_g,bar_c), excluding c, is BRST stable and fixed Phi is invariant
verify the two-by-two constraint-gauge FP matrix is the identity
evaluate the actual quantum ghost phase's raw ordered Berezin coefficient -1/hbar^2 and the declared normalized zero-mode factor +1
verify the declared bosonic Fourier phase has unit pairing matrix and contract a generic Phi,p-dependent local test polynomial to its T=c=0 value
derive the regulated identity pairing from S_red and the separately declared reduced canonical measure, and verify its epsilon->0 distributional limit
keep the old proper-time source, full path BFV measure, full-real-lapse delta(C), global cycle and every physics output fail-closed

numerical_plan.quadrature: compare direct real-x integration of K_epsilon(x)*exp(-alpha*x^2) with 1/sqrt(1+4*alpha*epsilon)

decision_table.condition: upstream provenance is exact; the Darboux/static identities, bracket-derived BRST nilpotency, gauge-fixing density, endpoint stability, FP/normalized-Berezin convention, local zero-mode contraction and declared reduced relational identity control all pass
decision_table.meaning: keep one internally consistent local U_plus improved-static BFV replacement-source algebra and its zero-mode convention, compatible with the separately declared reduced canonical identity; a two-endpoint full BFV trajectory kernel, absolute path measure, old-kernel equality, full-real-lapse delta(C), other gauges/components and global physics remain open
